go2rtc.description: Enter the URL of your own go2rtc instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:1984), or leave it blank to use Home Assistant's built-in go2rtc. When using the built-in go2rtc, the card's `resource` is a camera entity (e.g. camera.driveway); with your own instance it is a stream name from your go2rtc config.
